review_complete_meaning: Actual source contact sheets, important original RGB, all ten final paired comparison sheets, current Blender/GLB meshes, required records, depth arrays, projection, semantic components and static contacts/proxies inspected. Review complete does not certify visual fidelity or native input truth.

issues.title: Required evidence and final budget accounting verified

evidence.detail: All required artifacts and analysis records are present. V1/v2/v3 snapshots and reports each contain exactly the prescribed ten samples; 30 completed paired views total, no supplemental views recorded. Snapshot SHA256 values match their respective checks; v3 and input_final match the current model. Exactly three saved 180-frame passes correspond to initial, major-repair and final geometry. The final candidate remains ready_for_independent_review.

issues.recommendation: Retain all version snapshots, paired outputs and three full input passes; no fourth full input pass is permitted.

issues.title: Requested rod directions are preserved in final geometry

evidence.detail: Fresh inspection of all 975 requested rods gives maximum world endpoint error 1.4952e-6 m. Explicit examples include pendant_00__radial_0, plant_below_mirrors__stem_00, coffee_table_far__rib_00, floor_lamp_0__leg_1 and wall_emblem__horn_horizontal_1. The saved paired RGB no longer shows the initial vertical rib spikes.

issues.recommendation: Keep the corrected rotation-mode assignment order and endpoint audit on future builds.

issues.title: Inward closed meshes and bevel degeneracies repaired in both artifacts

evidence.detail: Both current artifacts have 1,602 mesh components; 1,577 are closed after position welding. All closed components have positive signed volume. No triangle area below 1e-12 m² or nonfinite normal was found. Blender polygon normals are nonzero; GLB exports NORMAL attributes. Open foliage and pendant bowls are intentionally excluded from closed-volume claims.

issues.recommendation: Preserve outward face winding and avoid bevel widths that collapse thin counter or back faces.

issues.title: Wall seam backing and service aperture are technically sound

evidence.detail: Final sample74 has zero missing domain pixels versus 2,325 initially; sample61 has 3 versus 4,508. Actual panels have continuous structural backing with aperture splits. Service passage nominal clearance is 1.05 m wide by 2.24 m high; an interior-margin box x[3.48,4.18], y[-0.80,0.20], z[-0.155,2.035] intersects neither any mesh AABB nor any AABB proxy. Seat proxies are remote from this box. The passage enters a bounded inferred 1.5 m vestibule. Exterior door pairs are explicitly closed and blocked by glazing, consistent with source imagery.

issues.recommendation: Retain the open aperture and split proxies. Describe only static crossing into the bounded vestibule; do not imply measured hidden connectivity or navigation certification.

issues.title: Major solid seat-base penetrations removed

evidence.detail: Convex separating-axis checks on the actual eleven base footprints find no interpenetrating pair; minimum separating gap is 0.0059998 m. Final collider polygon vertices match exported base vertices. The author explicitly models shared modular boundaries and labels the hidden boundary shape inferred. Visual seat shape and yaw errors remain under M2-I08.

issues.recommendation: Preserve the shared-boundary construction and matching collision prisms when adjusting seat silhouettes.

issues.title: Pendant correspondence, ordering and bowl profiles remain visibly inaccurate

evidence.detail: The foreground pendant13 correction is supported in33/129: sample129 RGB box [597,83,724,120] changes from +3.3815 m to -0.0738 m median model-minus-DA3 depth. Nevertheless, actual comparisons82 and108 show missing or misplaced silhouettes and different overlap ordering across the ceiling; sample129 still has misaligned mid-distance lamps. Smooth concentric bowls do not reproduce the source weave. The author records tentative distant lamp identities.

issues.recommendation: Prioritize reliable lamp correspondences and silhouette ordering across82/108 as well as33/129; retain uncertain identities as inferred. Use source bowl outlines and weave appearance for any later authorized refinement, keeping cameras and scale fixed.

issues.title: Reception silhouette improves but cross-view depth evidence remains contradictory

evidence.detail: The sample100 floor intrusion box [920,580,1080,780] improves from -2.1291 m to +0.2314 m median signed residual. In desk boxes33 [575,443,678,465] and129 [919,568,1014,594], final medians are -1.4835 m and +1.8137 m respectively; the129 residual worsens from +0.9433 m. End-wall boxes33 [450,250,900,340] and129 [816,366,1239,427] remain -2.6239 m and +0.9268 m. Actual source/comparison imagery supports a closer desk silhouette, while the faceting and wall proportions remain approximate. These are conflicting predicted depths, not measurements of truth.

issues.recommendation: Keep both residual signs and the RGB silhouette evidence visible in uncertainty records. Any later placement revision should jointly constrain33/100/108/118/129; do not translate or rescale the whole shell to chase a mean residual.

issues.title: Appearance and several projected object contours remain simplified

evidence.detail: All ten final comparison sheets were visually inspected. Mirror layout and planar reflection shading improve in61/74, and door rails are thicker, but entrance frames still look thin relative to source108. Seat heights, back curvature and yaws remain visually wrong in61/129/155; near-seat box155 [780,730,1080,950] remains -0.6413 m median residual. Floor dash contrast and bright lamp reflections are much weaker in91/100/108. Yellow planters resemble sparse straight sprigs, the grass species differ, and reception trees are nearly bare in108/118/129. Wood grain and lighting are flatter. Reflected furniture has not been duplicated as real objects.

issues.recommendation: Prioritize seat contour/back yaw using61/129/155, door widths using100/108/118, then floor pattern/reflection balance and plant crown fullness. Keep procedural detail, shaders, light placement and hidden form explicitly inferred.

object: native pose and predicted depth consistency
issues.title: Large full-input outliers persist and have evidence of prediction-window discontinuities

evidence.detail: Independent resampling of the existing input grid gives median DA3 8.095 m at20 and19.627 m at21, and7.942 m at166 versus18.748 m at167. At these window transitions the native pose steps are4.14/8.32 mm and0.031/0.067 degrees; source contact sheets show almost unchanged lobby views. Frame175 median depth is0.372 m. Final signed medians are about -12.38 m at21/22, -11.67 m at167/168, and+5.31 m at175. This supports DA3 window inconsistency as a substantial contributor without certifying native pose or model accuracy. Final full-pass MAE is1.4262 m versus0.6491 m for the fixed ten.

issues.recommendation: Retain these frame-specific conflicts and the distinction between predicted input consistency and reconstruction accuracy. Do not move per-frame cameras, rescale depth, or trim masks to suppress them.

issues.title: Small support intersections remain

evidence.detail: Fresh component bounds put four rounded vessels 0.030 m below the floor surface and the two tree urns 0.020 m below it. Furniture feet and planter bases placed on the slab pass through the inset by roughly0.0175 m. Major furniture and column support bounds otherwise meet the floor within floating-point tolerance; floor-lamp rods extend about0.0009 m below it. These are small contact approximations rather than the initial major overlapping seat solids.

issues.recommendation: For later physics-ready cleanup, flatten or lift vessel bottoms and offset furniture contacts to the local finish height; regenerate matching proxies. No dynamic support or navigation simulation is certified.

visual_evidence_inspected.older_versions: Existing v1/v2 numerical arrays, hashes, records and initial review inspected; their comparison images were not separately visually inspected in this final review.

limitations: DA3 is a prediction, not ground truth. Native input pose accuracy is not certified.
Static component topology, bounds, rod endpoints, seat-base separation and portal proxies were checked; arbitrary all-pairs mesh intersections and dynamic physics were not exhaustively simulated.
Hidden vestibule extent, material, lighting, plant detail and many contact surfaces remain inferred.
The author build program was read; reviewer did not rebuild geometry or render GLB. Procedural material appearance parity in another GLB renderer is not certified.
Historical budgets/access use retained artifacts and declared logs; they are not OS-enforced historical provenance.
